title: Rotation-Record Points — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Rotation-record points.** On a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty treadwear adjustment credit, the set's Crestline rotation records add points to the covered-mileage percentage. The count is every Crestline rotation record on the set, with or without balancing; the miles run are the latest tread inspection odometer less the install odometer.

- **5 points** — at least one rotation, and at least as many rotations as the miles run divided by 5000, rounded down.
- **2 points** — at least one rotation, fewer rotations than that, but at least as many as the miles run divided by the line's largest rotation gap, rounded down.
- **0 points** — any other set.

The line's largest rotation gap is 6,000 miles on the Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty line and 7,500 miles on every other line (7500, 7500, 7500, 6000, 7500, 7500 in line order).

| Hypothetical set (7,500-mile line) | 5,000 test | Gap test | Points |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31,000 miles run, 6 rotations | 6 needed — met | — | 5 |
| 31,000 miles run, 4 rotations | 6 needed — not met | 4 needed — met | 2 |
| 31,000 miles run, 3 rotations | not met | 4 needed — not met | 0 |
| 4,000 miles run, 0 rotations | — | — | 0 (no rotation) |
